# The Semgrep engine used by .github/workflows/semgrep.yml.
#
# A file rather than an inline `pip install semgrep`, so that Dependabot can
# see it: the `pip` entry for this directory in .github/dependabot.yml opens a
# pull request when a new engine release lands. The two alternatives are both
# worse. An unpinned install scans with whatever shipped that morning, so the
# scanner that gates every pull request can change under us without a commit;
# a pin that nothing watches silently stops gaining engine fixes, which is the
# failure the `github-actions` entry below it was added to stop. See #1280.
#
# This does NOT pin the rules. p/javascript, p/nodejs and p/secrets are fetched
# from the registry at scan time, so new rules arrive without a bump here -
# which is the right way round: the engine is infrastructure, the rules are the
# point.
semgrep==1.182.1
